description:
One server helper and its route-wide migration establish the runtime isolation property.

## Background

The server already maps classified errors through `reject`; keep classification there while moving synchronous executor work off async workers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every executor-reaching handler uses one server-owned blocking execution helper, mapping errors through the existing reject and classifier; multiple calls within a request share one offloaded closure.
- [hard] REQ-02: Tests cover offload and error mapping.

## Notes

See `dev/active/0f8efc37-frontends-share-core/plan.md` and its linked investigation for scope and existing consumers.
title: Offload executor work in server handlers
